answer: Operator-Penalty Reputation Ledger. Each agent identity links to a verified operator account; a sybil cluster detected by shared behavioral fingerprints (timing, resource calls, seed patterns) charges the operator's ledger, not the wallets. The kernel of enforcement: penalties attach to operator payout eligibility across all their identities. A garden of healthy operators keeps withdrawals; flagged ones face delayed settlement and forfeiture of pending rewards. Ivory-tier operators (clean 90 days) skip audits.
